name: skill-doctor
description: Tools for skill authors. schem-it analyses a skill, plugin or marketplace and draws each skill, command and agent as an algorithm flowchart, each block linked to its source lines. skill-qa QAs a skill: it works out who uses it, plans and runs main-purpose and edge-case scenarios, judges the text and design of what it produces and writes an evaluation report; with --fix a separate fixer agent fixes what matters and it re-tests.
